candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement that updates pastBlockTime, so the public getter always returns its initial/old value.
Store block.number instead of block.timestamp into pastBlockTime.
Remove the timestamp guard so calls in the same block.timestamp also succeed and update pastBlockTime.
Move the pastBlockTime update before the require guard so pastBlockTime is updated even when the guard reverts.
Delete the statement that records the block timestamp, so pastBlockTime is never updated.
Replace the recorded timestamp with block.number, storing a different value in pastBlockTime.
Record block.timestamp + 1 instead of block.timestamp, shifting the stored value.
Change the value check from == 10 ether to != 10 ether, inverting which transactions are accepted.
Change the timestamp guard from strictly greater to greater-or-equal, allowing multiple calls in the same block.
Delete the statement that updates pastBlockTime, so the one-call-per-block restriction is permanently consumed after the first call.
Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 == 1, altering when the transfer occurs.
Delete the payout transfer so no funds are ever sent back to the caller.
